name: foundation
description: Foundation: one marketplace for the Claude Code plugins Cadence, burnrate, Headroom and Seldon. Each plugin lives in its own repository.

plugins.name: cadence
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin that brings engineering practices to software you'll keep running after the session ends. It writes a plan before code, commits once per task, holds tests to a stopping rule, and checks the result against your goal. Its records live in your repository, so a new session picks up where the last one stopped.

plugins.name: burnrate
plugins.description: Builds a local, self-contained dashboard of your own Claude Code token usage from your transcripts, and answers quick usage questions in chat.

plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Reminds you to /clear with a toast when your session's context fills past a point you choose, then again each step after. The toast stays out of the transcript, so a reminder costs no tokens.

plugins.name: seldon
plugins.description: Does the design work before Cadence builds. It interviews you about what you want to build, then writes a brief, a PRD, an architecture spine and a set of epics into .planning/seldon/, so Cadence starts from fixed boundaries and small phases.
